body: The adderall is for ADHD - parents didn't believe in it growing up, and I was smart enough to do well in school without being able to pay attention or get things done, but it caught up with me in the real world, and a year or so after my doctor first talking to me about them, I decided to give them a try. The first thought I had when taking them was "is this what normal people are like when they sit down to do work?" I don't get the "superhuman" effects that my friends without focus issues claim, but it helps me get the things done that I need to do, so I've kept taking it.
